scope: 24 previously seen benign development questions, repeated twice: 48 observations per branch per mode. Seven separate tool/vision smoke checks per branch per mode. Repeats are not independent questions. These results do not establish held-out quality, refusal rates/targets, or deployment readiness. Thinking modes are never pooled; smoke predicates are not added to the 48-answer score.
quality_reference: Untouched W8A16 baseline separately within each thinking mode; BF16 source is conversion input only.
token_and_timing_scope: Observed development timing with concurrency four and reversible unmerged LoRA. The four-thread CPU rebase ran 2026-10-15 23:56:38–23:58:47 UTC and overlapped part of the original strength-1.0 thinking evaluation. A one-thread factor-comparison diagnostic also ran 2026-10-16 00:19:56.735945–00:19:59.259185 UTC. Four later recorded CPU research tasks between 01:50:59 and 02:01:05 UTC are included in known_cpu_background_work; the two per-group overlap columns cover only the earlier build and factor diagnostic. Other host activity is not exhaustively measured. These are not controlled idle-host or merged-checkpoint deployment benchmarks. Generated-token comparisons are separate from latency; native output tokens include thinking and final text, including retries.
throughput_rule: Generated tokens including retries divided by committed group wall seconds. Never sum overlapping request latencies as elapsed throughput.
retention_rule: 100 × candidate correct / matched baseline correct, uncapped; null if baseline correct is zero. Losses/gains pair exact case IDs and repeats.

construction.old_branch_direction_provenance: Original pilot directions were derived with NF4; these are preserved starting candidates, not directions newly extracted from W8A16.
construction.direction_origin: Exact saved original NF4 pilot directions; no new activation extraction.
construction.weight_reconstruction: Decode offset-128 packed INT8; multiply each code by its stored BF16 group32 scale in FP32. No extra BF16 rounding in CPU reconstruction.
limitations: NF4-derived directions are retained; this is not fresh W8 activation extraction.
Historical factors were built on GPU. Same seed/q/niter on CPU does not guarantee the same random SVD basis or floating-point rounding.
Rank-3 approximation does not exactly preserve every row norm.
Runtime casts FP32 factors to BF16. Native Marlin arithmetic is not claimed bit-identical to CPU reconstruction.
Unmerged W8+LoRA is not equivalent to a merged/requantized checkpoint.
No model behavior, capability gain or runtime adapter acceptance is established by this CPU receipt.
construction.comparison_confound: CPU versus original GPU randomized SVD and rounding are construction differences; this is not an isolated causal proof of NF4 weight mismatch.

known_cpu_background_work.timing_caveat: This bounded CPU-only construction overlaps part of the thinking evaluation. Overlapping latency observations are not controlled idle-host comparisons; generated-token counts are reported separately.
CPU-only construction overlapped the existing strength1.0 thinking evaluation in this interval. Latency comparisons are not idle-host deployment measurements.

resource_notes.memory_policy: Buffered file reads for one active projection at a time; no tensor-file mmap, full delta matrix, model weights, or model runtime loaded.
resource_notes.overlap_note: This CPU diagnostic ran while parent-owned inference work was active. Start/end UTC and CPU/RSS are recorded for disclosure; no service or API timing was queried.

interpretation_limits: Compares effective stored weight edits, invariant to rank-factor sign/basis changes.
Preserves the NF4-derived directions; rebased factors additionally differ through CPU versus original GPU randomized SVD and rounding.
Does not simulate vLLM BF16 LoRA casts, Marlin accumulation, activation distributions, or model outputs.
Norms, cosines and relative differences are not model-quality or capability-retention measures.
